title: Budget and cleanup
contract: If budget covers requested units, acquire all units without exceeding budget and release every acquired unit.
scope: Requested units and budget 0..3; admission n<=budget; no allocation failure other than budget.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: Peak resource count does not exceed budget.
All requested units are acquired and final live count is zero.

variants.description: Use one bulk reservation and release.
